'''''Phoenix Home''''', or '''''Phoenix Base''''',<ref name="Epic Battles">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]''</ref> was a repurposed [[Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigate]]<ref name="Databank" /> under the command of [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] in the [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Starship|vessel]], the headquarters of [[Phoenix Cell]], participated in a number of battles with the rebel [[fleet]] that it led until it was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in his [[TIE Advanced x1]] during an [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (4 BBY)|attack]] on the fleet<ref name="Siege of Lothal" /> in [[4 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> Following the destruction of ''Phoenix Home'', Sato transferred his command to the [[CR90 corvette]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']].<ref name="Sato Databank">{{Databank|commander-jun-sato|Commander Jun Sato}}</ref> The loss of ''Phoenix Home'' was a devastating blow to the Rebels, severely limiting their ability to fight the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]].<ref name="The Lost Commanders">{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}}</ref>

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] had a [[Unidentified Pelta-class frigate|''Pelta''-class frigate]] that they modified to the specifications of the ''Phoenix Home''.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Phoenix Home ''first appeared in the one-hour TV movie ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]: [[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal|The Siege of Lothal]]''.<ref name="Siege of Lothal" /> It also had a [[Star Wars: Armada|''Star Wars'': Armada]] expansions pack, the ''[[Phoenix Home Expansion Pack]]''.<ref name="Phoenix Home Expansion Pack">{{Armada|set=Phoenix Home Expansion Pack}}</ref>
